productOnPage.title: Astrid the Astronaut Pack
productOnPage.author: Rie Neal
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Astrid shows that you don’t have to be perfect to chase something huge—you just have to keep trying. Her science-filled adventures make space feel exciting and remind kids that curiosity is its own kind of superpower. Blast off with Astrid in this fun, STEM-filled chapter book series about friendship, teamwork, and reaching for the stars! Astrid dreams of becoming the first astronaut with hearing aids—and she’s determined to make it happen through her Astronomically Grand Plan. From joining her school’s space club to tackling science projects and robotics competitions, Astrid is ready to face any challenge that gets her one step closer to space.Along the way, she learns that teamwork, communication, and believing in herself are just as important as any scientific breakthrough. Whether she’s building rockets, growing plants like real astronauts, or programming a robot surprise for her teacher, Astrid’s adventures show that curiosity and courage can take you anywhere.This pack includes:1. The Astronomically Grand Plan (Astrid the Astronaut #1)2. The Unlucky Launch (Astrid the Astronaut #2)3. Hydroponic Hijinks (Astrid the Astronaut #3)4. Robot Rebellion (Astrid the Astronaut #4)Originally published in print by Simon & Schuster, LLC Tracks included: Chapter 1 - Free Fireworks Chapter 2 - All Alone Chapter 3 - Shooting Stars Chapter 4 - Gum Drops and Tooth Picks Chapter 5 - A Giant Mess Chapter 6 - Friends For Never Chapter 7 - Robot Junkyard on the Kitchen Table Chapter 8 - The Real Astro Mission Chapter 9 - Right Answer Chapter 10 - My New Plan The End
productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Blast off with Astrid in this fun, STEM-filled chapter book series about friendship, teamwork, and reaching for the stars! Astrid dreams of becoming the first astronaut with hearing aids—and she’s determined to make it happen through her Astronomically Grand Plan. From joining her school’s space club to tackling science projects and robotics competitions, Astrid is ready to face any challenge that gets her one step closer to space.


Along the way, she learns that teamwork, communication, and believing in herself are just as important as any scientific breakthrough. Whether she’s building rockets, growing plants like real astronauts, or programming a robot surprise for her teacher, Astrid’s adventures show that curiosity and courage can take you anywhere.


This pack includes:

1. The Astronomically Grand Plan (Astrid the Astronaut #1)

2. The Unlucky Launch (Astrid the Astronaut #2)

3. Hydroponic Hijinks (Astrid the Astronaut #3)

4. Robot Rebellion (Astrid the Astronaut #4)


Originally published in print by Simon & Schuster, LLC
